title: Coach campaign operators toward real-world outcomes
detail: Admin campaign review offers attendance, return visits, bookings and useful replies as goals. Validated coaching questions and deterministic checklist replace open-rate optimization. Raw email counts and attribution limits are visible; no generated publication copy is inserted. Goals are per-review selections, not stored program objectives. Real campaign outcome attribution and holdout learning are not implemented by this phase.

verify.evidence: Bounded actual-source probe passed with inert IO. Cumulative integration: 35 focused suites, 411 passed, one live-provider test skipped; changed-file ESLint and full TypeScript pass. Frequency compile-only build and all six local artifact gates pass. These are cumulative local checks, not independent phase artifacts, authenticated production, provider or DB acceptance. Migration remains prepared only (OWN-109).
